description: No JSON-LD anywhere on the site. Identity (name/type/offering) is stated clearly in prose instead. Structured data is absent, not wrong -- absence alone must never be a finding.
notes: D-ENTITY-05 (no identity anchor) is a compound check that only fires alongside D-ENTITY-01 or -02; since name/type are clearly stated in prose, neither fires, so -05 correctly stays silent even though there genuinely is no sameAs/url anchor. D-EXTRACT-03/04 stay silent here on their merits: detect_extract() IS invoked by the real pipeline (an earlier orchestrator wiring gap that blocked it has been fixed), and D-EXTRACT-04 demonstrably fires end to end on the invalid-structured-data fixture, so this fixture's clean D-EXTRACT result reflects its clean content rather than an unrunnable check. D-EXTRACT-03 additionally requires a PROBE observation, which is unavailable in this environment and is reported as an UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUMENT coverage entry rather than as a pass.
